responsibility: Implements the bit-level comparison node used by GCC's symbolic-execution subsystem to represent per-bit path conditions. This file provides the runtime behavior of bit_condition objects: constructing and deep-copying condition expressions, exposing the stored tree_code relational operator, and printing the comparison operator used in dumps, so symbolic states can carry explicit GT/LT/EQ/NE relationships between value_bit operands.
same_name_distinction: Implements the out-of-line behavior of the condition model declared in sym-exec-condition.h: bit_condition construction/copying, tree_code access, and condition-operator dump printing. Unlike the header, it does not define the condition_status enum or class interface; it supplies the executable methods for that condition-specific node type.
